main_text.head: Explicatio 2.
main_text.p: Successerunt igitur Ugri seu Juhri circa A. C. 900, qui ingenti multitudine ex remotissima Scythia, atq; ab ultimo glaciali Oceano, adventantes hodiernum Imperium Ungarorum condiderunt.Hos successerunt cesserūt Ugri Nam qvos nunc vocamus Ungaros, non ab antiquis illis Hunnis, sed a recentioribus Ugris originem trahunt.qvi re- gnum Hunga- ricum condi- derunt
main_text.head: Explicatio 1:
main_text.p: Ab his Ugris Germania ineffabiles calamitates sensit, cum eam irrumpentes obvia omnia sacra & profana prosternerent, & usq; ad Germaniam inferiorem omnia exscinderent sub regibus Taxon & Caizà & aliis, qvorum qvinq; simul suspendit Otto I Imperator Ratisponæ.& Ger- maniâ afflixe- runt Ex-

page.notes: Page number printed as "6s" with a doubtful final glyph; read as 65. Marginal notes on the right were transcribed in their printed line breaks.
